import io
import polars as pl

# Create a sample DataFrame
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie"],
    "age": [25, 30, 35],
    "salary": [50000.0, 60000.0, 75000.0]
})

print("Original DataFrame:")
print(df)

# Serialize to Parquet in memory using a BytesIO buffer
buffer = io.BytesIO()
df.write_parquet(buffer)

# Reset buffer position to the start for reading
buffer.seek(0)

# Read the Parquet data back into a new DataFrame
df_restored = pl.read_parquet(buffer)

print("\nRestored DataFrame:")
print(df_restored)

# Verify round trip
print("\nRound trip successful:", df.equals(df_restored))

```python
import io
import polars as pl

# Create a sample DataFrame
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie"],
    "age": [25, 30, 35],
    "salary": [50000.0, 60000.0, 75000.0]
})

print("Original DataFrame:")
print(df)

# Serialize to Parquet in memory using a BytesIO buffer
buffer = io.BytesIO()
df.write_parquet(buffer)

# Reset buffer position to the start for reading
buffer.seek(0)

# Read the Parquet data back into a new DataFrame
df_restored = pl.read_parquet(buffer)

print("\nRestored DataFrame:")
print(df_restored)

# Verify round trip
print("\nRound trip successful:", df.equals(df_restored))
```
